_comment: ATTACK_REACTION_PLAYED_OR_ACTIVATED was set by nothing. The check is CHAIN-LINK scoped, which nothing recorded: a turn-scoped record would let a reaction from the turn's first attack keep answering yes for every later attack. The ATTACK_CLASS_IN 'assassin' gate was invented -- the card names no class -- and LOSE_LIFE defaulted to SELF, so the card would have drained ITS OWN controller rather than the attacking hero.
